title: Why nobody trusted money before this gold coin
title_alternatives: One of the first gold coins was baked in salt
How do you trust a coin? This gold coin fixed it
description:
This is one of the earliest known coins of pure gold, and it exists because nobody could tell how much gold was in the coins before it. Sardis refiners packed electrum in salt and baked it until the silver drew off, and Croesus is credited with the pure gold and silver coins that followed.
